option_relations.rationale: Meningitis is an inflammation of the meninges, typically caused by infection, and is not directly related to a fourth ventricle cyst (Dandy-Walker variant).
Neurocysticercosis is a parasitic infection causing cysts, but the leaf specifies a congenital fourth ventricle cyst (Dandy-Walker variant), not an infectious cyst.
Ependymoma is a type of brain tumor. The leaf describes a congenital cyst (Dandy-Walker variant), not a tumor.
Hemangioblastoma is a vascular tumor. The leaf describes a congenital cyst (Dandy-Walker variant), not a tumor.
